title: Return Policy - Laptops, Renewed
text:
This policy covers renewed laptops bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. Renewed laptops are tested, cleaned and repaired where needed before they are sold, and they can be sent back within 90 days of the day you received them, for a full refund or a replacement unit of the same kind. The time limit counts from the day the laptop reached you, not from the day you placed the order, and it is the same for every screen size and colour.

What to send back

Renewed laptops must come back with the charger, the power cable and every accessory or guide that came in the box. Use the original packaging if you still have it, or a sturdy carton with enough padding to stop the laptop moving. Before you pack it, copy any files you want to keep, sign out of every account, turn off any device tracking and reset the laptop to its factory settings. We erase every laptop that comes back, but we cannot recover your files once the laptop has left your hands. A laptop with a cracked screen, liquid damage, missing keys or signs that it has been taken apart is not accepted and will be shipped back to you. Remove any stickers or covers you added to the lid.

How to start a return

To start a return for renewed laptops, sign in to your account, go to your order history and choose the laptop you want to send back. We email you a prepaid shipping label and a return code to write on the carton, and you can drop the parcel at any shipping point listed on the label. You can also bring the laptop to the service desk in one of our stores, where a team member checks it with you before the return is accepted. Keep the tracking number or the desk slip until your refund arrives.

Your refund

Once the renewed laptop has arrived and passed its check, we send the refund to the payment method you used. Refunds usually reach your account within a few business days, depending on your bank. Gift card payments are refunded to a gift card, and a payment split across several methods is refunded in the same split. We email you as soon as the refund has been sent, and the email lists every item it covers.

Items we cannot take back

Software licences, digital downloads and subscriptions bought with renewed laptops cannot be sent back once they have been activated, because they cannot be taken back from the laptop. A laptop that is locked to an account we cannot remove, or that was reported lost or stolen, is not accepted. Laptops that have had parts swapped, such as memory or a storage drive, are accepted only with the original parts put back in place. Accessories bought in the same order, such as a mouse or a laptop bag, follow the same time limit as the laptop they were bought with.

Exchanges

If you would rather have a different size or colour, you can exchange renewed laptops within the same time limit. The exchange follows the same steps as a return, and the replacement ships as soon as the original laptop has passed its check. If the replacement costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we refund the difference to you. When the laptop you want is not available, we tell you straight away and you can choose a refund instead.
